schemaEvolution.changes: Initial schema with call metadata, transcript, facts, risks, provenance
Removes duplicated auto-synced metadata; adds ALREADY/NOT AUTO-SYNCED sections; references GHL task ID

designRules: Never duplicate call metadata already auto-synced by JustCall to GHL
Always include the normalized transcript (not raw, not summarized)
Facts must be directly supported by transcript evidence
Risk flags must be explicit and actionable
Provenance must include provider transcript hash for auditability
Production effects block must always state zero for all categories before approval
